NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 9 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 8 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 3, 12:36 PM ET

The Seahawks are the top-projected defense on the Week 9 DraftKings main slate at 8.6 DraftKings points for $3,800, against Arizona. Texans (7.7, $3,500) and Chiefs (7.3, $3,700) are next.

The Eagles return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.52 projected points per $1,000 at $2,500.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 3, 12:36 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 9

Seahawks, SEA vs ARI ($3,800)

Seahawks carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.6 DraftKings points at $3,800. That is 0.9 points clear of Texans. The salary works out to 2.26 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 9 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Seahawks averaged 8.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.6, and it holds 2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is a 10.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 26.5 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Eagles, PHI vs NYG ($2,500)

Eagles projects for 6.3 DraftKings points at $2,500, which works out to 2.52 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 9 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Eagles averaged 6.5 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 16.8, and it holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Philadelphia is a 3.5-point underdog at home against the Giants, with an implied team total of 18 in a game totaled at 39.5.
